text:
6. 2. 5. 1. 

(Pātubhāva suttaṃ)

(Sāvatthi nidānaṃ)

42. Channaṃ bhikkhave pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ. Katamesaṃ channaṃ:

Tathāgatassa arahato sammā sambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ, tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ, ariyāyatane paccājāti dullabhā lokasmiṃ, indriyānaṃ avekallatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ajaḷatā anelamūgatā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, kusaladhammacchando dullabho lokasmiṃ. 

Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave channaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
